characters.summary: Thaal Sinestro fused with the fear entity Parallax gains god-like cosmic manipulation capabilities, leveraging pure terror to warp reality, generate massive yellow energy constructs, and overwhelm planetary defenses.
weaknesses: Vulnerability to willpower-based entities under specific resonance conditions
limitations: Requires sustenance or connection to fear
Can be separated from the host by powerful willpower constructs or entities

sources.supports: General history and Parallax possession events.
Parallax Sinestro capabilities and power set.

feats.claim: Terrorized entire star systems and overpowered multiple Green Lanterns simultaneously while bonded with Parallax.

notableResults.note: Hal Jordan eventually separated Parallax from Sinestro.

conditional.ability: Cosmic reality-warping and immense fear-based amplification

campaignTags.claim: Flight powered by the yellow light of fear.

unknowns: Exact limits of reality manipulation while bonded to Parallax.

limitations: The White Ring can reject its wielder if their emotional balance falters.

feats.claim: Wielded the White Lantern ring to combat cosmic-level threats during the Green Lantern run.

conditional.ability: Creation of life and total emotional spectrum control

campaignTags.claim: Flight powered by the White Ring of Life.

unknowns: Duration of proficiency with the White Lantern ring before relinquishing it.
